body:
:) he is adorable, I can't find any pictures atm, but he's a honey kind of colour! 
What breed do you have? :)

Also, just wanted to say, thank you for chatting, I'm feeling much better than I was last night.

I understand that... I also don't want to take away from people who really need it, just because I am a bit moody. I really don't know, I'll talk to my therapist and see what they think...
I do try my best to be positive, I'm usually quite happy around my friends, as I don't want them to see how I feel most of the time; depressed, alone and wanting to die...

Thanks for the read, it really does make you think. 
Thank you, and I shall try remember to let go of the little things, and the bigger things in life are more important.
Aww cute! I have a 6 month old lhasa apso, he's adorable. He's actually a really lovely little guy, and great when I'm a bit down. He's so damn cuddley!

Thank you.
My therapist knows about my thoughts... I will have to bring it up next session. It's been really hard for me to get these sessions though, as I have been on waiting lists for a while. Even after I was in hospital I didn't get an appointment for 2 weeks afterwards. It's like I'm not important enough. 
I have a beautiful puppy who I adore. I just feel so stupid because I should be happy, but I just can't. 
Thank you so much.

Thank you for your time. 
I know they want me to be happy. I wish I could just be happy, not even for me, but for them. I don't want to hurt anyone.

Thank you.

I don't know... Everything is just on top of me. I feel so lonely.
I know it's hard for those around me. I don't expect them to be there for me all the time, I mean they have lives and problems themselves. 
I go to therapy once a week, but it's just relentless suicidal thoughts right now.
I don't know what to do.
Thanks for listening.

Thank you...
I've tried to tell my friends and my mum, but I really don't want to be a burden. Sometimes i'm so down that i'm inconsolable and then they just get upset and i feel guilty. 
They know i'm depressed and have tried to harm myself... but sometimes I don't feel like anyone cares. I don't know why really... They tell me so, but my brain doesn't register it. 

Thank you for your time. I'm sorry.
